claims.text: Aside from the form Nielíqui, there were other variations on her name: Nielikki or Nyelikki, and Nieliqi. Nielikki was perhaps intended to be a "pet-name form" of Nieliqi. She was also called Wendine (meaning "Little Maiden" in Qenya).

Wynne), p. 69; J.R.R. Tolkien, "Early Elvish Poetry and Pre-Fëanorian Alphabets", in Parma Eldalamberon XVI (edited by Christopher Gilson, Arden R. Smith, Patrick H. Wynne, Carl F. Hostetter and Bill Welden), p. 90; J.R.R. Tolkien, "Early Qenya and The Valmaric Script", in Parma Eldalamberon XIV (edited by Carl F. Hostetter, Christopher Gilson, Arden R. Smith, Patrick H.
